device.note: tlc5620.pdf (SLAS081E) p.1 (pinout), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3-4 (data interface, Figures 1-4, Table 2 serial input decode), p.6 (recommended operating conditions, timing)

registers.note: DAC B input latch (double buffered); power-on value not given (0 used)

registers.note: per-DAC range bits (0 = 1 x REF, 1 = 2 x REF) from the serial word, collected in one internal register

protocol.note: p.3: with LOAD high, DATA is shifted on each CLK falling edge (CLK low between bytes, Figures 3-4 -> mode 1); LOAD pulsed low latches the 11-bit word into the selected DAC. LOAD is the active-high frame pin: the last 11 bits before LOAD falls are decoded (leading don't-care bits of the 16-clock transfers are skipped)

ldac.note: LDAC low: the selected DAC output updates when LOAD falls; LDAC high: values held until LDAC is pulsed low (p.3)

power-on contents of the latches are not given (0 used)
